title: Sanskrit varsity ‘mock funeral’ row: Pinarayi Vijayan alleges conspiracy by ex-Governor Arlekar, V-C against SFI activists

ai.summary: Kerala's opposition leader Pinarayi Vijayan accused former Governor Arlekar and SFI's suspended activists of conspiring to falsely report a mock funeral, while students demanded revocation of their suspension and continued a 12-day fast.

facts.claim: Keralam’s Opposition Leader Pinarayi Vijayan has alleged a conspiracy by former Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar and Vice-Chancellor (V-C) of Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit (SSUS) Ciza Thomas in connection with the controversy over the complaint that activists of the Students Federation of India (SFI) had carried out a mock funeral of the V-C.
facts.quote: Keralam’s Opposition Leader Pinarayi Vijayan has alleged a conspiracy by former Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar and Vice-Chancellor (V-C) of Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit (SSUS) Ciza Thomas in connection with the controversy over the complaint that activists of the Students Federation of India (SFI) had carried out a mock funeral of the V-C.

facts.claim: Addressing the relay fast staged by the suspended SFI activists at the SSUS main campus in Kalady near here on Friday, Mr. Vijayan alleged that the V-C had not raised any compliant of a mock funeral initially. However, such a false complaint was lodged after a few days.
facts.quote: Addressing the relay fast staged by the suspended SFI activists at the SSUS main campus in Kalady near here on Friday, Mr. Vijayan alleged that the V-C had not raised any compliant of a mock funeral initially. However, such a false complaint was lodged after a few days.

facts.claim: Mr. Arlekar, “who has always implemented the wishes of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh”, played a key role in coming up with “a lie” that the protesting students held her mock funeral, he said.
facts.quote: Mr. Arlekar, “who has always implemented the wishes of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh”, played a key role in coming up with “a lie” that the protesting students held her mock funeral, he said.

facts.claim: He also accused Chief Minister V. D. Satheesan and Higher Education Minister Roji M. John of not trying to address the indefinite fast organised by the suspended students.
facts.quote: He also accused Chief Minister V. D. Satheesan and Higher Education Minister Roji M. John of not trying to address the indefinite fast organised by the suspended students.

facts.claim: The SFI staged an ‘Occupy Sanskrit University’ protest on Friday as its State leadership reiterated the demand that the suspension of its 16 activists must be revoked unconditionally.
facts.quote: The SFI staged an ‘Occupy Sanskrit University’ protest on Friday as its State leadership reiterated the demand that the suspension of its 16 activists must be revoked unconditionally.

facts.claim: P. S. Sanjeev, SFI State Secretary, said the students would not tender any apology as directed by the varsity Syndicate.
facts.quote: P. S. Sanjeev, SFI State Secretary, said the students would not tender any apology as directed by the varsity Syndicate.

facts.claim: The police on Friday shifted three SFI activists, including the federation’s unit president Archana P. S, who had been on a relay fast over the last 12 days, to hospital citing their deteriorating health.
facts.quote: The police on Friday shifted three SFI activists, including the federation’s unit president Archana P. S, who had been on a relay fast over the last 12 days, to hospital citing their deteriorating health.

ai.background_note: SFI activists were suspended for staging a mock funeral protest at Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit, leading to a 12-day fast and police intervention.
